description: This file defines a static helper class TokenCredentialHelper for creating Azure service clients (Table and Queue) with appropriate credentials, including support for emulators, environment-based credential selection, and managed identities.

classes.name: TokenCredentialHelper
classes.description: A static utility class providing methods to create Azure service clients with appropriate credentials, including support for emulated environments and managed identities.

methods.name: CreateTableServiceClient
methods.description: Creates a TableServiceClient for the given URI, using an emulator connection string if the URI is a loopback, otherwise authenticates with a token credential.

methods.name: CreateQueueServiceClient
methods.description: Creates a QueueServiceClient for the given URI, using an emulator connection string if the URI is a loopback, otherwise authenticates with a token credential.

methods.name: GetTokenCredential
methods.description: Determines and returns an appropriate TokenCredential based on environment variables; uses ClientAssertionCredential if specific environment variables are set, otherwise defaults to DefaultAzureCredential.

methods.name: GetManagedIdentityToken
methods.description: Obtains an access token for a Managed Identity with the specified audience.
